articles.summary: Pick the segment, the message and the time. Boom sends it once to each person, lets the agent answer on WhatsApp and closes the campaign on its own when it's done. Step by step.
articles.title: How to send a campaign to a segment, once

articles.summary: Customers answer more when there's something in it for them. A journey can now offer a gift card for replying, Boom checks who qualifies and you approve every one. Here is how it works.
articles.title: Get more replies with a reward
